Method of Attack: Info-stealer malware that steals passwords stored in Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, as well as cryptocurrency wallets
Delivered via malspam campaign using macro-laced Excel spreadsheet attachments with malicious VBS macros
Downloads payloads including DLLs and executables from multiple sites such as GitHub
Uses base64 encoding and byte reversal to evade detection
Creates persistence via new registry key and modifies Windows Defender via PowerShell to exclude .exe files from scanning
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Chrome, Edge, Firefox browsers
Attack Vector: Malicious Excel email attachments with macro-laced spreadsheets
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious traffic captured in PCAP published by Brad Duncan
